facts.fact: The auto industry accounted for 23% of all retail sales in the US in 2022, according to eMarketer as cited by StackAdapt.
facts.quote: The auto industry accounted for [23% of all retail sales](https://www.emarketer.com/content/auto-sector-dragging-down-us-retail?ecid=NL1014) in the US in 2022.

facts.fact: Car buyers spend an average of nearly 14 hours online during their research, according to Cox Automotive's 2019 car buyer journey study.

facts.fact: More than 75% of US adults spend up to 2 hours watching short-form digital video content every day.
facts.quote: More than [75% of adults](https://whatsnewinpublishing.com/over-82-of-internet-traffic-will-be-online-videos-by-2022-how-publishers-can-scale-their-content-production/#:~:text=Cisco%20recently%20declared%20that%20by,really%20hard%20to%20keep%20up.) spend up to 2 hours watching short-form digital video content every day.

facts.fact: In 2022, more than 82% of all consumer internet traffic watched online videos, which is 15 times higher than in 2017.
facts.quote: In 2022, more than 82% of all consumer internet traffic watched online videos, which is 15 times higher than in 2017.

facts.fact: US advertisers increased programmatic video spend from $52.17 billion USD in 2021 to $62.96 billion USD in 2022, according to eMarketer.
facts.quote: US advertisers increased their spend from $52.17 billion USD in 2021 to $62.96 billion USD in 2022.

facts.fact: More than half of car shoppers walk into a nearby car dealership as the common form of initial contact.
facts.quote: walking into a nearby car dealership remains the common form of initial contact, by more than half of car shoppers.

facts.fact: Multi-channel targeting enables advertisers to reach users across different platforms and channels, which StackAdapt says helps a campaign achieve greater reach.
facts.quote: [Multi-channel targeting](https://www.stackadapt.com/resources/blog/multi-channel-strategy) enables advertisers to reach users across different platforms and channels.

facts.fact: StackAdapt states that a successful multi-channel auto campaign requires a cohesive message across all available channels.
facts.quote: The key to a successful multi-channel auto campaign is to create a cohesive message across all of the available channels.
